description: This file defines a generic class 'GenericAsyncBatchObserver<T>' implementing 'IAsyncBatchObserver<T>' for asynchronous batch observation, including methods for handling next items, completion, and errors.

classes.name: GenericAsyncBatchObserver<T>
classes.description: A class that observes batches asynchronously, allowing clients to specify custom handlers for batch items, errors, and completion.

methods.name: GenericAsyncBatchObserver
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the observer with delegate handlers for next items, errors, and completion.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Handles the reception of a batch of items asynchronously.
